name: dreamplango
description: DreamPlanGo monorepo: Python audit engine (engine/), TypeScript API (api/) and prototype web app (web/)

scripts.engine:lint: uv run --project engine ruff check engine/src engine/tests
scripts.fetch:ev8: uv run --project engine dpg fetch eurovelo EV8
scripts.ingest:ev8: uv run --project engine dpg ingest eurovelo EV8
scripts.contracts: uv run --project engine dpg schemas && json2ts -i schemas/bundle-v0.schema.json -o packages/contracts/src/bundle.ts --no-additionalProperties --bannerComment "/* Generated from schemas/bundle-v0.schema.json by `npm run contracts`. Do not edit. */"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @dpg/api" "npm run dev -w @dpg/web"
scripts.test: npm run engine:test && npm run test -w @dpg/api
